item.title: White Bear Lake Police Chief Dale Hager will retire May 8, the city has announced
item.description: White Bear Lake Police Chief Dale Hager will retire May 8, the city of White Bear Lake announced on Monday in a Facebook post. Hager became chief in 2023 and overall spent 12 years with the city, including working as an administrative captain in the police department. He retires with 29 years of law enforcement experience.
